items.tags: The image features girl centered in the frame from the mid-thigh up,set against a background of white clouds in a light sky. girl is a girl with short white hair,blunt bangs,and bright blue eyes. She has pink blush on her cheeks and a small tan bandage on her left cheek. She is wearing a thick white hood with large,rounded bear ears,and a brown bear-faced sleep mask rests on her forehead. Two dark,star-shaped clips pin her hair on the right side. She is dressed in a light cream,off-the-shoulder top with a white ruffled neckline,exposing her upper chest and shoulders. The garment is decorated with a large brown bear face print on the center and smaller bear heads and clouds across the fabric,gathered by a dark brown ribbon near the waist. Her right arm hangs downward while her left hand is raised near her shoulder,and she has an open-mouthed smile. Surrounding girl are several small,brown teddy bears floating in the air. One bear on the top right wears a blue nightcap with white stars,while others on the left and right wear small blue bow ties. Thin,bright blue ribbons swirl through the air around girl and the bears.
